pages.title: Grid transfer and parameter transfer
pages.text:
Grid transfer and parameter transfer
A new grid can sample the same function family and operator.
A new diﬀusivity changes
the attenuation itself; successful grid reuse does not establish parameter transfer.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 20

pages.title: Closed state and effective closure
pages.text:
Closed state and eﬀective closure
The heat ﬁeld is a closed autonomous state.
Omitting ionic variables from a voltage
evolution can instead produce a learned eﬀective closure limited to its trajectory
distribution.
Computational Cardiology Notes 20 / 20
